title: VILNIS: west coast machine
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: VILNIS ("wave" in Latvian), a west coast SRC machine inspired by Majella Audio's Implexus and Compax and by the Buchla Music Easel: a complex oscillator (a modulation oscillator at a ratio, FM, AM or both) into a sine wavefolder with HARMONICS and BIAS, then a low pass gate with a vactrol-like decay, a pulser that strikes it again and again, a random voltage and a vibrato. Page 2's FOLD and VIB draw the waveform and the gate's level. Machine 36. Needs machine-pages and core 4.4.
